description:
Never lose track of a subsidy again.

Subsidy Manager brings your offered, active and completed subsidies together in one native-style overview.

See what subsidies are available, track progress, rewards and deadlines, and review previous outcomes without hunting through notifications.

Open Subsidy Manager from the bottom-right toolbar beside Industry Statistics. Choose In Progress, Offered or History, then click a subsidy to open the game's native details and Accept/Decline controls where available.

Use Refresh at any time to update the overview.

Subsidy Manager works with the game's existing subsidy system and does not alter subsidy rules or game balance.
name: Subsidy Manager
summary: View, track and manage offered, active and completed subsidies in one place.
